headings.usage: Use for all main dashboard headings, KYC status banners, and section titles. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Use for forms, tables, rejection reasons, and general dashboard text. Opt for higher line-height (leading-relaxed) for readability.

labels.usage: Use for KYC status tags, form field labels, and table column headers.

glassmorphism.usage: For the KYC locked overlay, sticky headers, and action modals.

borders.usage: Use 1px subtle inner strokes to define surfaces rather than heavy drop shadows.

textures.usage: Apply a very subtle SVG noise or grain texture over the main background to prevent it from looking like a flat, cheap void.

bento_grid.description: Use for the Admin Dashboard KYC queue and Label Profile Checklist.

kyc_blur_overlay.description: For unverified users clicking restricted tabs (e.g., Analytics, Payouts).
kyc_blur_overlay.structure: The background content must render but have a 'blur-md opacity-40 pointer-events-none' applied. Overlay a centered modal with 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0F0F]/90 border border-white/10' that forces them to the KYC settings.

spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for dashboard cards to maintain a premium feel. Do not cramp form inputs.

file_upload.name: KTP & Logo Uploader
file_upload.design: A dashed border zone (border-white/20) with a subtle bg-white/5 background on hover. Must show clear file size limits (5MB for logo, 10MB for KTP) and allowed formats. Include a secure preview state once uploaded.

status_banner.name: KYC Status Banner
status_banner.design: Placed at the top of the Profile/Settings page. If Rejected, must heavily feature the 'Rejected' red and distinctly display the Admin's rejection reason in a distinct blockquote style.

rejection_modal.name: Admin Rejection Reason Dialog
rejection_modal.design: When Admin clicks 'Reject', open a Shadcn Dialog requiring a text input for the reason. Primary action is 'Confirm Rejection' in destructive red.

locked_tab.name: Restricted Navigation Item
locked_tab.design: Display a small lock icon next to restricted routes in the sidebar. The link remains clickable but triggers the kyc_blur_overlay on the destination route instead of a hard redirect.

motion.hover_states: All buttons should use smooth 'transition-colors duration-200'. Upload zones should have a slight scale effect 'hover:scale-[1.02]'.
motion.overlay_entrance: The KYC restriction overlay must fade in 'animate-in fade-in duration-300' to emphasize the lock.
motion.list_stagger: Admin KYC queues should use staggered entrance animations for rows to make the review process feel dynamic.

placeholders.description: Hand holding a card - useful as a placeholder/illustration for the KTP verification empty state
Dark music studio vibe for aesthetic background or dashboard greeting section

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Unverified labels can click locked tabs' rule exactly as requested: do NOT redirect via React Router.
Instead, render the restricted page component, but wrap its main content in a blur overlay (blur-md) with pointer-events-none, and mount a fixed, centered KYC action modal on top of it.
Ensure 'Super Admin' and 'Admin Support' roles can access the KYC review queue, which includes the KTP viewer and the required rejection reason form.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all icons, particularly the Lock icon for restricted tabs and identity icons.
Do not use generic HTML inputs for file uploads; create a premium dropzone component with Shadcn structure.
Strictly adhere to the dark mode palette: #050505 background with #0F0F0F cards. Avoid #7351B7 completely.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in dropdowns or modals. Always use a solid dark background or backdrop-blur with a dark tint.
For KTP preview, ensure the image scales to fit within the modal/container without breaking the layout (object-contain).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where overlays are needed.
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp or subtle rounded) with interaction animations & relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use Tailwind's generous scale (p-6, p-8, p-12).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='kyc-upload-button', data-testid='kyc-rejection-reason').
